coverage_notes: Viewed every registered location on PDF pp.4-7, methods on p.3 and title/context pp.1-2. All Figure 1 category/processing labels and Tables 1/3 values were actually viewed; no thresholds were inferred from continuous polarization curves.
shared_qualifications: All pitting potentials and printed uncertainties in Tables 1/3 are already mV vs SCE. CRA Min/Max equal central minus/plus the printed uncertainty; the source does not identify that uncertainty as SD, SE or an experimental range. Its statistical meaning is not invented.

C17: nominal atomic ratios are compared to CRA wt.% using w_i=100 n_i M_i / sum(n_j M_j). Atomic masses (CIAAW abridged 2024, https://ciaaw.org/abridged-atomic-weights.htm): Al26.982, Si28.085, Ti47.867, V50.942, Cr51.996, Fe55.845, Co58.933, Ni58.693, Cu63.546. These are conversion constants only, not external experimental evidence.

C17 uses the printed formula subscripts as relative atomic coefficients, including the outer coefficient for each element inside parentheses: (TiAl)0.7V0.15Fe0.1Ni0.05 -> Ti0.7 Al0.7 V0.15 Fe0.1 Ni0.05; Ti0.3(CoCrFeNi)0.7 -> Ti0.3 Co0.7 Cr0.7 Fe0.7 Ni0.7. Group interpretation is explicitly conditional because no bulk analytical composition is supplied. It is not silently reinterpreted as 70 or 30 at.% of a combined group. Identity is additionally supported by the named table result, electrolyte, method and printed uncertainty.

The CSV integer compositions are only approximate nominal chemistry and need not equal a measured bulk analysis. AlCoCrCuFe has all atomic coefficients1; AlTiVCrSi all1; CoCrFeNiAl0.9 has Co/Cr/Fe/Ni1 and Al0.9; CoCrFeNi all1. Do not copy the Ti-rich phase-A EDS values in Table 4 as bulk alloy composition.

AlCoCrCuFe processing conflict is in the source: Fig.1 labels SPS, while Fig.2/text call the selected sample as cast. The consolidated registry/Table 1 result is retained with that unresolved qualification. CoCrFeNi SPS* and SPS^ schedules are distinct; CRA 579 identifies the Table 3 SPS^ result, not the separate -28 mV SPS* presentation.
